text:
Type: flatwoven diamond pattern rug
Use: defining a seating or work area; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: modern, contemporary, Scandinavian
Materials: flat woven fibers, textured weave
Colors: cream, slate blue grey, mustard gold
Shape: rectangular, central band of small intersecting diamonds fading into cream ends, flat thin profile, medium size
Feel: relaxed, textured, fresh, subtle
Goes with: dark or light wood floors, grey upholstery, woven baskets; modern, Scandinavian or coastal rooms

product.name: Rivet Modern Flatwoven Rug with Intersecting Diamonds, 5' x 8', Blue and Gray with Gold
product.description: This contemporary rug will add texture, depth, and color wherever you have a bare floor or need to create visual interest in a room. Its classic coloring ensures that it will pair with many color schemes. Flatwoven wool and cotton mean this soft rug will bring warmth to any room. 5'W x 8'L 77% wool, 16% cotton, 7% Lurex Transitional design in colors that can be paired with any decor Flatweave (pile is not applicable) Pair with a rug pad (sold separately)
